Messages.Author: invisibl...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Yes, this is stupid, given what Monger tells us. But it came up in a
game tonight, so I figured I'd ask to get an official answer.

Two Siren's Lure may not be played during a single action, even if
played by two different vampires, correct?

Thanks.

John Eno

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:


I think you are correct.
According to the card text from Siren's Lure, ypu may only use it "when
a minion attempts to block".
After you use the first one, this condition is not fulfilled anymore
(beacuse "That minion cannot block this action"), so you are not
allowed to use the second one.

Siren's Lure [BL:R1, LoB:R]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Melpominee/Celerity
[cel] This vampire burns 2 blood to get +1 stealth.
[mel] Only usable by an untapped ready vampire other than the acting
minion when a minion attempts to block. That minion cannot block this
action. Tap this vampire and that minion. Once the action resolves,
this vampire enters combat with that minion.
[MEL] As [mel] above, but do not tap this modifying vampire.

Take care,

Hardy Range

> According to the card text from Siren's Lure, ypu may only use it "when

> After you use the first one, this condition is not fulfilled anymore
> (beacuse "That minion cannot block this action"), so you are not
> allowed to use the second one.
>

Another minion may then attempt to block, so your reasoning fails. You
might want to play Siren's Lure on the second block attempt, but cannot
because you can only "queue up" one combat.

> Siren's Lure [BL:R1, LoB:R]
> Cardtype: Action Modifier
> Discipline: Melpominee/Celerity
> [cel] This vampire burns 2 blood to get +1 stealth.
> [mel] Only usable by an untapped ready vampire other than the acting
> minion when a minion attempts to block. That minion cannot block this
> action. Tap this vampire and that minion. Once the action resolves,
> this vampire enters combat with that minion.
> [MEL] As [mel] above, but do not tap this modifying vampire.

--
- Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
